name: io.github.sonilo-ai/sonilo-mcp
title: Sonilo Music & Sound Effects
description: Licensed soundtracks and sound effects matched to your video. Commercial use OK.

environmentVariables.name: SONILO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Sonilo API key from platform.sonilo.com/dashboard/api-keys. Optional: leave it unset to use the credential written by `sonilo login`.

environmentVariables.name: SONILO_MCP_BASE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Default output directory and file-access confinement boundary

environmentVariables.name: TIME_OUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for streaming music, uploads and downloads; task-based tools always wait at least 2700s for their task
